definitions.explanation: Describes an appearance that is both beautiful and well-balanced. Often used for people with refined, elegant features, or for things with a clean, polished beauty.

examples.japanese: {端麗|たんれい}な⟦{顔立|かおだ}ち→顔立ち：14687_kaodachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{女性|じょせい}→女性：01617_josei⟧だ。
examples.english: She is a woman with graceful features.

examples.japanese: ⟦{容姿|ようし}→容姿：12293_youshi⟧{端麗|たんれい}な⟦{俳優|はいゆう}→俳優：03547_haiyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{話題|わだい}→話題：03793_wadai⟧になった。
examples.english: A handsome actor became the talk of the town.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{日本酒|にほんしゅ}→日本酒：12954_nihonshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{端麗|たんれい}な⟦{味|あじ}わい→味わい：11899_ajiwai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{飲|の}みやすい→飲みやすい：21767_nomiyasui⟧。
examples.english: This sake has a clean, refined flavor and is easy to drink.

notes:
{端麗|たんれい} describes beauty that is well-proportioned, refined, and elegant. A literary and formal word.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{容姿|ようし}→容姿：12293_youshi⟧{端麗|たんれい}: beautiful appearance, good-looking (a set four-character phrase, very common)
- {端麗|たんれい}な⟦{顔立|かおだ}ち→顔立ち：14687_kaodachi⟧: graceful, well-proportioned features

SAKE TERMINOLOGY:
- {端麗|たんれい}⟦{辛口|からくち}→辛口：18794_karakuchi⟧: clean and dry (describes sake with a crisp, refined flavor)
- ⟦{淡麗|たんれい}→淡麗：20762_tanrei⟧: sometimes written with this kanji in sake contexts, emphasizing lightness

REGISTER:
Literary and formal. Rarely used in casual conversation. Most commonly encountered in the compound ⟦{容姿|ようし}→容姿：12293_youshi⟧{端麗|たんれい}, which appears in written descriptions, formal contexts, and job/dating profile language.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧: beautiful (general, common word)
- ⟦{麗|うるわ}しい→麗しい：08184_uruwashii⟧: beautiful, lovely (literary)
- ⟦{端正|たんせい}→端正：14887_tansei⟧: neat and orderly in appearance (similar formality, slightly different nuance emphasizing orderliness)
